name: Wuhan Financial Holdings (Group) Co., Ltd. (Wuhan Jinkong, 武汉金融控股集团)
via: Wuhan Financial Holdings Group holds 50% of Huayuan Securities and is its actual controller, per Huayuan Securities' shareholder page; the group says it is a wholly state-owned enterprise of Wuhan city and the city's only first-level state financial platform
note: Wuhan's sole municipal-level state financial holding platform; the group's site lists 137 wholly-owned or controlled subsidiaries. On 4 March 2026 it became the controlling shareholder of Wuhan Three Towns FC, per Tencent News (17 March 2026).
